schema.name: connections
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE connections ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), name TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, api TEXT NOT NULL, -- NULL means the kind's default. base_url TEXT, -- Write-only secrets, encrypted with the server secret (PROVIDERS §5). Header values -- often carry credentials too, so only header names are ever shown. api_key_enc BLOB, key_hint TEXT, headers_enc BLOB, header_names_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK (json_valid(header_names_json)), compat_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(compat_json)), cache_ttl_s INTEGER CHECK (cache_ttl_s IS NULL OR cache_ttl_s > 0), max_concurrent INTEGER CHECK (max_concurrent IS NULL OR max_concurrent >= 1), -- The per-connection proxy override (PROVIDERS §6.2). proxy_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inherit' CHECK (proxy_mode IN ('inherit', 'direct', 'custom')), proxy_url_enc BLOB, preset_override_ref_id TEXT REFERENCES entity_refs(id), row_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, deleted_at INTEGER, bin_item_id TEXT, -- Purged connections stay as tombstones, so old messages and ledger rows still -- name their model (PROVIDERS §10). purged_at INTEGER, credential_id TEXT REFERENCES credentials(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, headers_origin TEXT, cache_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, CHECK ((api_key_enc IS NULL) = (key_hint IS NULL)), CHECK ((proxy_mode = 'custom') = (proxy_url_enc IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (purged_at IS NULL OR (api_key_enc IS NULL AND headers_enc IS NULL AND proxy_url_enc IS NULL AND base_url IS NULL)) ) STRICT

schema.name: forks

schema.name: llm_requests
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE llm_requests ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), connection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES connections(id), model_id TEXT REFERENCES models(id), chat_id TEXT REFERENCES chats(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, rollout_id TEXT REFERENCES rollouts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, version_id TEXT REFERENCES versions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, purpose TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (purpose IN ('generation', 'summarize', 'condense', 'decision', 'workshop', 'idle_job', 'edit', 'test')), -- What was requested. api TEXT NOT NULL, provider TEXT NOT NULL, model_key TEXT NOT NULL, -- What served it: the model the response named, and the routed upstream where a -- gateway reports one (OpenRouter). response_model TEXT, upstream TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('running', 'complete', 'failed', 'aborted', 'interrupted')), started_at INTEGER NOT NULL, first_token_at INTEGER, ended_at INTEGER, -- Normalized counts (PROVIDERS §9.2). cache_write_long is the subset of cache_write -- written with the long TTL; reasoning is the subset of output. input_uncached INTEGER, cache_read INTEGER, cache_write INTEGER, cache_write_long INTEGER, output INTEGER, reasoning INTEGER, usage_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' CHECK (usage_source IN ('reported', 'estimated', 'none')), -- The provider's usage object verbatim, so counts can be recomputed if a -- normalization turns out wrong. raw_usage_json TEXT CHECK (raw_usage_json IS NULL OR json_valid(raw_usage_json)), reported_cost REAL, cost REAL, cost_currency TEXT, -- What produced cost: a built-in price source, 'reported', or a user formula. cost_formula TEXT, error_json TEXT CHECK (error_json IS NULL OR json_valid(error_json)), cache_stagger_json TEXT CHECK (cache_stagger_json IS NULL OR json_valid(cache_stagger_json)), cache_identity_json TEXT CHECK (cache_identity_json IS NULL OR json_valid(cache_identity_json)), backfill_id TEXT REFERENCES jobs(id), reserved_tokens INTEGER, reserved_cost REAL, reserved_currency TEXT, CHECK ((status = 'running') = (ended_at IS NULL)), CHECK ((cost IS NULL) = (cost_currency IS NULL) AND (cost IS NULL) = (cost_formula IS NULL)) ) STRICT

NULL means unknown, not zero (as in reference-harness). llm_requests INTEGER, usage_input_tokens INTEGER, usage_output_tokens INTEGER, usage_cache_read_tokens INTEGER, usage_cache_write_tokens INTEGER, usage_cost REAL, cache_observed_json TEXT CHECK (cache_observed_json IS NULL OR json_valid(cache_observed_json)), error TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, started_at INTEGER, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, completed_at INTEGER , context_issues_json TEXT CHECK (context_issues_json IS NULL OR json_valid(context_issues_json)), history_start_slot_id TEXT, history_start_depth INTEGER, history_depth INTEGER, fork_id TEXT) STRICT

schema.name: changesets_rollout_id_same_chat

schema.name: chats_current_fork_mirrored

schema.name: chats_first_fork

schema.name: chats_leaf_own_slot

schema.name: chats_leaf_own_slot_insert

schema.name: chats_owner_fixed

schema.name: connections_cache_revision

schema.name: credentials_cache_revision

schema.name: credentials_owner_fixed

schema.name: entities_fork_parent
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER entities_fork_parent BEFORE INSERT ON entities WHEN NEW.forked_from_entity_id = NEW.id OR (NEW.forked_from_entity_id IS NOT NULL AND ( (SELECT owner_user_id FROM entities WHERE id = NEW.forked_from_entity_id) IS NOT NEW.owner_user_id OR (SELECT kind FROM entities WHERE id = NEW.forked_from_entity_id) IS NOT NEW.kind)) OR (NEW.forked_from_revision_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT entity_id FROM entity_revisions WHERE id = NEW.forked_from_revision_id) IS NOT NEW.forked_from_entity_id) OR (NEW.forked_in_chat_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT owner_user_id FROM chats WHERE id = NEW.forked_in_chat_id) IS NOT NEW.owner_user_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a fork''s parent is another entity of its owner and kind, its revision the parent''s, its chat its owner''s'); END

schema.name: entities_fork_parent_update

schema.name: entities_owner_fixed

schema.name: entity_refs_entity_fixed

schema.name: fork_overrides_delete_version_own
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fork_overrides_delete_version_own BEFORE INSERT ON fork_overrides WHEN NEW.kind = 'delete_version' AND (NEW.flag IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM versions o JOIN slots s ON s.id = o.slot_id WHERE o.id = NEW.target_id AND o.fork_id IS NULL AND s.id = NEW.slot_id AND s.depth = NEW.slot_depth)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a deleted swipe is one of its message''s own versions'); END

schema.name: fork_overrides_event_own

schema.name: fork_overrides_flag_set
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fork_overrides_flag_set BEFORE UPDATE OF flag ON fork_overrides WHEN NEW.kind IN ('star', 'picker_hide') AND NEW.flag IS NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a flag is set on one of its message''s own versions'); END

schema.name: fork_overrides_hide_range

schema.name: fork_overrides_identity_fixed
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fork_overrides_identity_fixed BEFORE UPDATE OF id, chat_id, fork_id, kind, target_id, slot_id, slot_depth ON fork_overrides BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'an override keeps its fork, kind and target'); END

schema.name: fork_overrides_replace_own
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fork_overrides_replace_own BEFORE INSERT ON fork_overrides WHEN NEW.kind = 'replace' AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM versions o JOIN slots s ON s.id = o.slot_id WHERE o.id = NEW.target_id AND o.fork_id IS NULL AND s.id = NEW.slot_id AND s.depth = NEW.slot_depth) OR (NEW.value_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM versions c WHERE c.id = NEW.value_id AND c.source_version_id = NEW.target_id AND c.fork_id IS NOT NULL))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a replacement stands a copy in for one of its message''s own versions'); END

schema.name: fork_overrides_replace_update_own
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fork_overrides_replace_update_own BEFORE UPDATE OF value_id ON fork_overrides WHEN NEW.kind = 'replace' AND NEW.value_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM versions c WHERE c.id = NEW.value_id AND c.source_version_id = NEW.target_id AND c.fork_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a replacement stands a copy in for one of its message''s own versions'); END

schema.name: fork_overrides_same_chat

schema.name: fork_overrides_select_message_own
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fork_overrides_select_message_own BEFORE INSERT ON fork_overrides WHEN NEW.kind = 'select' AND (SELECT fork_id FROM versions WHERE id = NEW.value_id) IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a selection names one of its message''s own versions'); END

schema.name: fork_overrides_select_own_version
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fork_overrides_select_own_version BEFORE INSERT ON fork_overrides WHEN NEW.kind = 'select' AND (NEW.slot_id IS NOT NEW.target_id OR NEW.slot_depth IS NOT (SELECT depth FROM slots WHERE id = NEW.target_id) OR (SELECT slot_id FROM versions WHERE id = NEW.value_id) IS NOT NEW.target_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a selection names a version of its slot'); END

schema.name: fork_overrides_select_update_message_own
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fork_overrides_select_update_message_own BEFORE UPDATE OF value_id ON fork_overrides WHEN NEW.kind = 'select' AND (SELECT fork_id FROM versions WHERE id = NEW.value_id) IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a selection names one of its message''s own versions'); END

schema.name: fork_overrides_select_update_own_version

schema.name: fork_overrides_slot_kinds

schema.name: fork_overrides_summary_choice

schema.name: fork_overrides_summary_choice_update
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fork_overrides_summary_choice_update BEFORE UPDATE OF value_id ON fork_overrides WHEN NEW.kind IN ('summary_choice','summary_superseded') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM summaries s WHERE s.id=NEW.value_id AND s.chat_id=NEW.chat_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a summary choice stays in its chat'); END

schema.name: fork_overrides_summary_rerun

schema.name: fork_overrides_summary_rerun_update
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER fork_overrides_summary_rerun_update BEFORE UPDATE OF value_id,flag ON fork_overrides WHEN NEW.kind='summary_rerun' AND (NEW.flag IS NULL OR (NEW.flag=1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM summary_reruns r WHERE r.id=NEW.value_id AND r.chat_id=NEW.chat_id AND coalesce(r.summary_id,r.job_id)=NEW.target_id))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a summary request names its own target'); END

schema.name: fork_overrides_summary_revision

schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER history_reduced_version AFTER UPDATE OF deleted_at ON versions WHEN OLD.deleted_at IS NULL AND NEW.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bin_items b WHERE b.id = NEW.bin_item_id AND b.origin_json ->> '$.forkId' IS NOT NULL) BEGIN INSERT INTO history_changes(slot_id, fork_id, chat_id, depth, revision) SELECT id, '', chat_id, depth, 1 FROM slots WHERE id = NEW.slot_id AND (selected_version_id = NEW.id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fork_overrides o WHERE o.target_id = NEW.slot_id AND o.kind = 'select' AND o.value_id = NEW.id)) ON CONFLICT(slot_id, fork_id, seq) DO UPDATE SET revision = revision + 1; END

schema.name: summaries_chain
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER summaries_chain BEFORE INSERT ON summaries WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lcm_enable_runs r WHERE r.id = NEW.id AND r.chat_id = NEW.chat_id AND r.phase = 'copy' AND r.gathered = NEW.slot_count AND json_extract(r.payload_json, '$.imported.firstSlotId') = NEW.first_slot_id AND json_extract(r.payload_json, '$.imported.lastSlotId') = NEW.last_slot_id) AND NOT EXISTS ( WITH RECURSIVE chain(id, parent_slot_id, n) AS ( SELECT id, parent_slot_id, 1 FROM slots WHERE id = NEW.last_slot_id AND chat_id = NEW.chat_id UNION ALL SELECT s.id, s.parent_slot_id, c.n + 1 FROM slots s JOIN chain c ON s.id = c.parent_slot_id WHERE c.n < NEW.slot_count AND s.chat_id = NEW.chat_id ) SELECT 1 FROM chain WHERE id = NEW.first_slot_id AND n = NEW.slot_count AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chain c JOIN slot_parents p ON p.slot_id = c.id) ) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'summary endpoints must form its declared primary-parent chain'); END

schema.name: summaries_immutable
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER summaries_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON summaries WHEN (OLD.sealed = 1 AND NEW.sealed <> 1) OR NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.chat_id IS NOT OLD.chat_id OR NEW.level IS NOT OLD.level OR NEW.first_slot_id IS NOT OLD.first_slot_id OR NEW.last_slot_id IS NOT OLD.last_slot_id OR NEW.slot_count IS NOT OLD.slot_count OR NEW.audience_json IS NOT OLD.audience_json OR NEW.rollout_id IS NOT OLD.rollout_id OR NEW.error_json IS NOT OLD.error_json OR NEW.batch_id IS NOT OLD.batch_id OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at OR (NEW.status IS NOT OLD.status AND NEW.status <> 'superseded') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'only summary selection, supersession and row version can change'); END

schema.name: summaries_seal
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER summaries_seal BEFORE UPDATE OF sealed ON summaries WHEN OLD.sealed = 0 AND NEW.sealed = 1 AND NOT coalesce(( CASE WHEN NEW.level = 1 THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM summary_inputs WHERE summary_id = NEW.id) = NEW.slot_count AND (SELECT slot_id FROM summary_inputs WHERE summary_id = NEW.id ORDER BY ordinal DESC LIMIT 1) = NEW.last_slot_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM summary_parents WHERE summary_id = NEW.id) ELSE (SELECT coalesce(sum(child.slot_count),0) FROM summary_parents p JOIN summaries child ON child.id = p.parent_id WHERE p.summary_id = NEW.id) = NEW.slot_count AND (SELECT child.last_slot_id FROM summary_parents p JOIN summaries child ON child.id = p.parent_id WHERE p.summary_id = NEW.id ORDER BY p.ordinal DESC LIMIT 1) = NEW.last_slot_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM summary_inputs WHERE summary_id = NEW.id) END ), 0) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'sealed summary lineage must cover its entire chain'); END

schema.name: summary_inputs_chain
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER summary_inputs_chain BEFORE INSERT ON summary_inputs WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM summaries s JOIN slots i ON i.id = NEW.slot_id WHERE s.id = NEW.summary_id AND s.level = 1 AND NEW.ordinal >= 0 AND NEW.ordinal < s.slot_count AND NEW.ordinal = coalesce((SELECT ordinal + 1 FROM summary_inputs WHERE summary_id = s.id ORDER BY ordinal DESC LIMIT 1), 0) AND CASE WHEN NEW.ordinal = 0 THEN NEW.slot_id = s.first_slot_id ELSE i.parent_slot_id = (SELECT slot_id FROM summary_inputs WHERE summary_id = s.id AND ordinal = NEW.ordinal - 1) END ) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'summary inputs must follow their declared chain in order'); END

schema.name: summary_parents_chain
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER summary_parents_chain BEFORE INSERT ON summary_parents WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM summaries s JOIN summaries child ON child.id = NEW.parent_id JOIN slots first ON first.id = child.first_slot_id WHERE s.id = NEW.summary_id AND s.level > 1 AND child.level < s.level AND child.id <> s.id AND child.sealed = 1 AND child.status <> 'failed' AND NEW.ordinal >= 0 AND NEW.ordinal = (SELECT count(*) FROM summary_parents WHERE summary_id = s.id) AND CASE WHEN NEW.ordinal = 0 THEN child.first_slot_id = s.first_slot_id ELSE first.parent_slot_id = (SELECT prev.last_slot_id FROM summary_parents p JOIN summaries prev ON prev.id = p.parent_id WHERE p.summary_id = s.id AND p.ordinal = NEW.ordinal - 1) END ) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'summary children must partition its chain at strictly lower levels'); END

schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_generation_ends_once BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON versions WHEN NEW.status = 'generating' AND OLD.status <> 'generating' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a version never goes back to generating'); END

schema.name: versions_identity_fixed
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_identity_fixed BEFORE UPDATE OF id, slot_id, ordinal, writer, origin ON versions WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.slot_id IS NOT OLD.slot_id OR NEW.ordinal IS NOT OLD.ordinal OR NEW.writer IS NOT OLD.writer OR NEW.origin IS NOT OLD.origin BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a version''s identity, slot, writer and origin never change'); END

schema.name: versions_model_content_frozen
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_model_content_frozen BEFORE UPDATE OF content ON versions WHEN OLD.writer = 'model' AND OLD.status <> 'generating' AND NEW.content IS NOT OLD.content AND NOT (NEW.purged_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.content = '' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM slots s JOIN chats c ON c.id = s.chat_id JOIN bin_items b ON b.user_id = c.owner_user_id AND b.chat_id = c.id WHERE s.id = OLD.slot_id AND ( (b.id = OLD.bin_item_id AND b.kind = 'version') OR (b.id = s.bin_item_id AND b.kind IN ('message', 'branch'))))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'model-written versions are immutable once generated; create a new version'); END

schema.name: versions_purge_final
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_purge_final BEFORE UPDATE OF purged_at ON versions WHEN OLD.purged_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.purged_at IS NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a purged version stays purged'); END

schema.name: versions_rollout_id_same_chat
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_rollout_id_same_chat BEFORE INSERT ON versions WHEN NEW.rollout_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT chat_id FROM rollouts WHERE id = NEW.rollout_id) IS NOT (SELECT chat_id FROM slots WHERE id = NEW.slot_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'versions.rollout_id must be in the same chat'); END

schema.name: versions_rollout_id_same_chat_update
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_rollout_id_same_chat_update BEFORE UPDATE OF rollout_id, slot_id ON versions WHEN NEW.rollout_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT chat_id FROM rollouts WHERE id = NEW.rollout_id) IS NOT (SELECT chat_id FROM slots WHERE id = NEW.slot_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'versions.rollout_id must be in the same chat'); END

schema.name: versions_source_cleared
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_source_cleared AFTER DELETE ON versions BEGIN UPDATE versions SET source_version_id = NULL WHERE source_version_id = OLD.id; END

schema.name: versions_source_fixed
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_source_fixed BEFORE UPDATE OF source_version_id ON versions WHEN NEW.source_version_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_version_id IS NOT OLD.source_version_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a version''s source never changes'); END

schema.name: versions_source_same_slot
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER versions_source_same_slot BEFORE INSERT ON versions WHEN NEW.source_version_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT slot_id FROM versions WHERE id = NEW.source_version_id) IS NOT NEW.slot_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a version''s source must be another version of its slot'); END
